text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Ugh... This is actual, literal hell...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what's up? "Hell" as in "hell yeah,"
am I
right?!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
This isn't a joke, okay?! We've had it
crazy rough
lately!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Every day, it's classwork, training, and dieting, over and over. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
I don't even wanna get up in the
mornings
anymore. This place might as
well be hell.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Well, in that case... I'm gonna
become an
angel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, I'd like to create a
heaven where
everyone is free to let
their inner party selves out
to have fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm so taken aback, I end up blurting my
thoughts
out loud before I can stop
myself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Right? That was my reaction too.
Anyway,
what do you think of the new
Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I believe my current self is quite worthy
of being
called angelic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's the vibe I'm getting too.
choice_data_list: Less of an angel and more... like a refined young lady?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But aren't angels, like, mega-cute,
sparkly, and
totes adorbs?! So I totally
nailed it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uh, I mean, I was accurate, was I not?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Well, I guess it's pretty in line with what you'd think an angel is like.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I dooo! I wanna make Tracen heavenly!
choice_data_list: Does Daitaku Helios want to be an angel?
Does Daitaku Helios want to be an angel?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Everyone's been high-key down lately—it's even started to rub off on me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So I was like, hey, what if I become
everyone's
hype angel and heaven this
place up? That's
gotta be the
solution! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So basically, you want to make the
academy more
fun for everyone? To
cheer them up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me, though, you've already
got the
angel thing down pat.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're always so bright and
cheerful, and
everyone smiles when
you're around! What does
that make you
if not an angel?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No cap?! So I've been an angel the
whole time?!
Guess I'll just keep being
me, then! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Still, if I don't make any changes, it'd be like snapping a selfie with no filter. I wanna shake things up with some effects!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's do some brainstorming!
We can
grab a few more people to help
out, too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Is this your way of saying... you're my
ride or die?!
Omigosh, bestie, forget me!
You're the real angel
here!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna have everyone hanging out
on cloud
nine! Operation: Helios's Hype
Heaven is a
gooooo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
By the way, your impression of that
heiress was
spot-on. Hard to imagine,
given how "Helios" you
usually are. I
guess that's what love does for you,

huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Impression? What are you talking
about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh. You were doing it subconsciously...
Sorry,
forget I said anything!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Um, bestie?! Don't leave me hanging!
Spill the tea
already!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But anyway, heaven means like, we
gotta get this
school flying, don't we?
Whaddya think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That sounds wild! How are you gonna do
that,
girl? Tell me all the deets!
